newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt holds 45 devil worshippers in custody.
newsitem.headline: Egypt holds 45 devil worshippers in custody.

text.p: Egyptian prosecutors on Thursday ordered 45 youths be held in custody for 15 days on suspicion of devil worship and blasphemy, security sources said.
Another 31 suspected members of the cult were released on bail.
The prosectors also asked the police to arrest 20 people still at large and suspected of the same crimes, for which the maximum penalty would be three years in prison, they added.
Interior Minister Hassan el-Alfi told reporters earlier that most of the cult members, aged between 16 and 28, had learnt the sect's doctrines during travels abroad.
The case was front-page news on Thursday in Egypt, where the authorities and the general public look askance at any religious practices outside conventional institutions.
The interior ministry said on Wednesday that the suspected members, mostly students and secondary school children, worshipped the devil and approved of drugs and sexual freedom.
It said police had confiscated pictures of semi-naked group members performing rituals daubed in blood and dressed in black. They also wore lipstick and nail polish.
